title: Đoạn văn và thông báo (3)
intro: Đề tốt nghiệp câu 1–12: điền từ vào quảng cáo, thông báo. Hay kiểm tra: từ loại (danh/động/tính/trạng từ), giới từ đi kèm, cụm từ cố định (collocation), to V / V-ing, liên từ.
instruction: Chọn phương án đúng cho mỗi chỗ trống.

items.title: Urbanisation
items.passage: In recent decades, more and more people have moved from rural areas to cities in search of better jobs and services. This process, known as urbanisation, has brought many (1) ___ to cities, such as modern infrastructure and more job opportunities. (2) ___, it has also created serious problems. Many cities are now (3) ___, and traffic jams have become part of daily life. The cost of housing has risen sharply, (4) ___ it difficult for young people to buy a home. To deal (5) ___ these issues, city planners are investing in public transport and building more green spaces. They hope these efforts will make cities more (6) ___ for everyone.

items.explain: Sau many cần danh từ số nhiều: benefits.
Ý trước tốt, ý sau xấu (đối lập): However.
Sau are cần tính từ: overcrowded (quá đông đúc).
Mệnh đề rút gọn chỉ kết quả: …, making it difficult…

items.title: Imperial Citadel
items.passage:
WELCOME TO THE IMPERIAL CITADEL
To help (7) ___ this World Heritage Site for future generations, please follow these rules:
• Do not climb on walls or (8) ___ any objects.
• Photography is allowed, but flash is not permitted (9) ___ the exhibition rooms.
• Please (10) ___ your voice down in temple areas.
• Litter must be put in the bins (11) ___ along the paths.
• Guided tours (12) ___ every hour from the main gate.

items.explain: help (to) + động từ nguyên mẫu: help preserve.
Song song với climb (sau Do not): touch.
Trong phòng trưng bày: in the exhibition rooms.
keep your voice down: nói nhỏ.
Rút gọn bị động: bins (which are) placed along the paths.
Lịch trình, chủ ngữ số nhiều: tours depart every hour.
